name: @reedchan/statusline
description: Replaces pi's footer with a labelled two-row status line: context pressure as a fixed-size meter, cache and cost, the model and effort level, and the latest turn's TTFT and decode throughput in tokens/second. An opt-in panel (ctrl+q or /breakdown) breaks the context window down by origin — the provider-reported total, messages, memory files, system and extension tools, skills, system prompt, autocompact buffer and free space — with share bars and arithmetic that closes.
author: Reed Chan <xinyuchen77@gmail.com>
